svg.title: A pointer is another object; a reference is another name
svg.desc: On the left, int* altitude_ptr{&altitude_m}; draws two stack boxes joined by an arrow: altitude_ptr holds the address of altitude_m, which holds 120. On the right, int& alt{altitude_m}; draws a single stack box holding 120 with two names above it, altitude_m and alt, joined to the box by a brace.
